name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: A styled native select element with the Input look, a chevron, options and option groups. Prefer Select unless you need the browser's own picker.
notes: Prefer Select for dropdowns: it has the Lantern popover, icons and keyboard support. Use Native Select only when you need the platform picker, for example a very long list on phones, or a value that must work in a plain form post without JavaScript.
The wrapper is w-fit by default. Pass className="w-full" to stretch the select; the open list is drawn by the browser.
